title: 第2章 是你推的吗？
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“林见微，你装什么清高？三年前若不是你费尽心机讨好爷爷，逼我娶你，你以为我会多看你一眼？”厉延洲眼底满是讥讽。

“既然你对我无心，那就签字。”

林见微面不改色，将协议书又往前推了半分。

厉延洲上下打量她，“你这三年来逆来顺受，忍气吞声，不就是为了让我多看你一眼？怎么，现在玩起欲擒故纵的把戏了？”

他嗤笑一声：“说吧，你到底想要什么？除了圆房，其他我都可以考虑。”

只要你安分守己，继续当好这个幌子。

“你是该给我补偿。”

林见微抬眼：“当年我爸妈心疼我，怕厉家看轻，一分彩礼没要，反倒给了我不少陪嫁。这三年里，我的嫁妆基本都花在了你和你们厉家人身上，这笔钱，你得一分不少地还我。”

厉延洲不过是政府部门的一个普通科员，月工资也就三十八块五。

再看他身上，穿得是崭新的的确良干部装，戴着上海牌手表。

平时还总爱跟那群所谓朋友聚会摆阔，抢着买单。

这些钱，哪一分不是从林见微这儿来的？

不止是他，就连他父母、弟弟妹妹，甚至乔书瑶，林见微当初为讨他欢心，也没少贴钱。

家里大大小小的开销，几乎全部由她包圆了。

嫁妆贴光了不说，她哥哥心疼她，还时常私下塞钱，生怕她受委屈。

“还有，我照顾你起居整整三年，你没给过我一分钱工资。就算按最低标准，请个保姆一个月也得十块钱。三年，一共三百六十块。”

“加上我花出去的陪嫁，总共是五千三百六十块。”

“林见微！”厉延洲猛地一拍桌子，“我给你脸了是不是？”

“延州，你好好说话。”

乔书瑶一瘸一拐地起身打圆场，“微微，你别往心里去，今天延州是关心则乱，火气大了些。你放心，我回头一定教训他……”

“不必。”林见微直接打断：“我跟他离婚后，他就是你的人了，你想怎么教训都行，哪怕拉到床上调教，都与我无关。”

“林见微！你嘴巴放干净点！别污了书瑶的名声！”

厉延洲被她露骨的话激得勃然大怒，扬起手就朝着林见微的脸扇了过去。

从前，他也不是没对林见微动过手，每次她都只会哭着躲闪，从来不敢反抗。

然而这一次，林见微非但没躲，反而一把抓住他的手腕，反手就给了他一个响亮的耳光！

Page (1/3)

"Lin Jianwei, why are you pretending to be noble? If you hadn't tried so hard to please grandpa three years ago and forced me to marry you, do you think I would have looked at you more?" Li Yanzhou's eyes were full of sarcasm.

"Since you have no interest in me, then sign."

Lin Jianwei's expression remained unchanged and he pushed the agreement forward by half a minute.

Li Yanzhou looked her up and down, "You have been submissive and swallowing your anger for the past three years, isn't it just to let me look at you more? Why, now you are playing hard to get?"

He sneered: "Tell me, what do you want? Apart from consummating the marriage, I can consider everything else."

As long as you stay on your toes and continue to be a good guise.

"You should compensate me."

Lin Jian raised his eyes slightly: "Back then, my parents felt sorry for me and were afraid that the Li family would look down on me. They didn't ask for a cent of the betrothal gift, but instead gave me a lot of dowry. In the past three years, my dowry has basically been spent on you and your Li family. You have to pay me back every penny of this money."

Li Yanzhou is just an ordinary clerk in the government department, and his monthly salary is only thirty-eight and a half yuan.

Looking at him again, he was wearing a brand new cadre uniform and a Shanghai brand watch.

Usually, I always like to party with those so-called friends to show off and rush to pay for the bills.

Which part of this money did not come from Lin Jianwei?

Not just him, but his parents, younger brothers and sisters, and even Qiao Shuyao, Lin Jianwei paid a lot of money to please him.

She paid for almost all of the family's expenses, large and small.

Even though the dowry was all gone, her brother felt sorry for her and often gave her money in private, for fear that she would be wronged.

"Also, I took care of your daily life for three years, and you didn't give me a penny in salary. Even according to the minimum standard, hiring a nanny costs ten yuan a month. Three years, a total of three hundred and sixty yuan."

"Including the dowry I spent, the total is five thousand three hundred and sixty yuan."

"Lin Jianwei!" Li Yanzhou slammed the table, "I gave you face, didn't I?"

"Yanzhou, please speak nicely."

Qiao Shuyao limped up and stood up to smooth things over, "Weiwei, don't take it to heart. Today Yanzhou will be confused if he cares, and he will get angry. Don't worry, I will teach him a lesson later..."

"No need." Lin Jianwei interrupted directly: "After I divorce him, he will be yours. You can teach him whatever you want, even if he is dragged to bed and trained, it has nothing to do with me."

"Lin Jianwei! Keep your mouth clean! Don't tarnish Shuyao's reputation!"

Li Yanzhou was angered by her explicit words. He raised his hand and slapped Lin Jianwei in the face.

In the past, it was not like he had never touched Lin Jian slightly. Every time she would just cry and dodge, never daring to resist.

However, this time, instead of hiding, Lin Jianwei grabbed his wrist and gave him a loud slap in the face with his backhand!
